theater: 中爪哇日惹、梭羅與山區

battle.name: 爪哇戰爭
battle.theater: 中爪哇日惹、梭羅與山區
battle.brief: 一八二五年七月二十日，日惹蘇丹長子迪波內加羅在塞拉宣布起兵，七月二十四日攻入日惹城，荷蘭總督德·科克自三寶壺率援軍北上，九月下旬解圍。卡面那件一五五〇年的西班牙火繩槍銃是雙方步槍的共同母型：荷軍已改用燧發步槍，爪哇起義軍手中仍有同源火繩短槍與自鑄銅砲，戰局其後轉入山區游擊。

kit.name: 火繩槍銃
kit.history: 比步槍輕的長槍。西班牙人帶著它上船，也帶著它進了美洲。

countries: 交戰的兩方，一方是荷蘭王國在爪哇的殖民當局：法律上由國王授權，實際由巴達維亞的總督府節制，作戰骨幹是荷屬東印度軍團，其中歐洲人營與從英屬印度調來的孟加拉、比哈爾土兵、爪哇本地步兵，以及佔全軍近半的皇家東印度砲兵；後方是總督府、三寶壺與日惹的軍需倉庫、三寶壺至梭羅的大郵路與沿途驛站，經費出自東印度群島的財政，也靠巴達維亞商會借款周轉。另一方是爪哇中部蘇丹國家的力量：日惹蘇丹宮、梭羅與馬加良卡兩位攝政王的宮廷，以及以卡伊·斯拉梅、卡伊·伊布拉希、卡伊·帕德萊甘為首的教團與村社網絡。迪波內加羅以奉蘇丹之名號召取得正當性，號召爪哇人以刀劍護教，得到中爪哇伊斯蘭村社提供的丁壯、糧秣與遮護。荷方的說法是恢復蘇丹宮秩序、保護歐洲商僑與傳教站、維護荷蘭政府對土地與稅收的權利；起義方的說法則是爪哇的村社與土地不該由巴達維亞的官吏與改宗傳教士支配。戰爭的地理範圍集中在中部爪哇，日惹、梭羅、馬加良卡三座宮廷城與其間的稻田、椰林、山嶺是主戰場，而三寶壺與沿海的港口是荷軍的補給源頭。
countriesEn: The two sides were the colonial authority of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Java and the armed strength of the central Javanese sultanates. On the Dutch side, power was granted by the king and exercised through the governor's council at Batavia; the fighting backbone was the Koninklijk Nederlands-Indisch Leger, made up of European companies detached from the battalions of the Royal Army of the Netherlands, Bengal and Bihar sepoys brought over from British India, Javanese infantry, and the Koninklijk Nederlands-Indische Artillerie, which by itself accounted for close to half the strength of the force. Behind them lay the governor's offices, the depots at Semarang and Yogyakarta, the great post road from Semarang to Surakarta with its relay stations, and the money came out of the East Indies treasury, with loans from the chambers of commerce at Batavia keeping the wheels turning. The other side was the court power of the Javanese sultanates: the palace of Yogyakarta, the two regencies of Surakarta and Magelang, and the network of religious teachers and village communities headed by Kyai Slamet, Kyai Ibrahim and Kyai Padelegan. Diponegoro borrowed legitimacy from the person of the sultan, called on the Javanese to defend religion with sword and lance, and drew his levies, his grain and his cover from the Islamic villages of the interior. The Dutch described their cause as restoring order in the sultan's palace, protecting European traders and mission stations, and safeguarding the rights of the colonial government to land and taxation; the insurgents answered that the villages and the land of Java must not be handed over to Batavian officials and Protestant missionaries. The fighting was concentrated in central Java: the three court cities of Yogyakarta, Surakarta and Magelang, and the paddy, coconut groves and hills between them, were the theatre, while Semarang and the coastal ports were the source of Dutch supply.
people: 爪哇一方的主角是日惹蘇丹哈孟庫布沃諾一世的長子迪波內加羅王子。他原本是宮廷中主張循舊例同荷蘭相處、維持宮廷權力分寸的一派，一八二五年上半年宮中兩派爭寵，他被排擠，其弟則被荷方另行抬出；宮廷同時答應向荷蘭移交部分土地與產業。他在外任巡視時得知這一連串消息，遂於七月二十日在中爪哇帕里克拉特附近的塞拉洞穴宣布獨立聖戰，兩個月內攻入日惹。他的兄弟帕庫阿拉姆一世與孟庫內加羅一世起初站在荷蘭一方或保持中立，日後才各走各路；教中人物則分頭號召：卡伊·帕德萊甘自德馬克一線西進，卡伊·斯拉梅在中部鄉間組織抵抗，卡伊·伊布拉希在克拉卡與芝拉扎一帶游擊。荷方關鍵人物是總督亨德里克·梅爾庫斯·德·科克，他在日惹解圍後主持大規模反攻，把保衛城市轉成消滅起義軍，又出任東印度的戰爭總監，推行小分隊搜索、招撫與封路並行；前線指揮先後有卡雷爾·雷尼爾與威廉·范德·杜伊斯·德·維爾布瓦斯；一八二八年自本土抵爪哇的增援營隊由特爾豪特率領；荷方代表安德里斯·博利厄則在七月二十四日日惹城門一帶的衝突中陣亡；最後一役則由總督古斯塔夫·威廉·范因霍夫拍板執行。
peopleEn: The central figure on the Javanese side was Prince Diponegoro, the eldest son of Sultan Hamengkubuwono I of Yogyakarta. He belonged to the palace party that favoured following the old precedent and living with the Dutch while keeping the measure of court power, and in the first half of 1825 the two factions at court fought for the sultan's favour: he was pushed aside, his younger brother was put forward with Dutch support, and the court at the same time agreed to hand over part of the palace lands and enterprises to the Dutch. Learning all of this while on tour outside the capital, he proclaimed a separate holy war at the cave of Sela near Parikkrat in central Java on 20 July, and within two months he was in Yogyakarta. His brothers Prince Paku Alam I and Prince Mangkunegara I stood with the Dutch or stayed neutral at first and only later went their separate ways; the religious leaders called in their own way: Kyai Padelegan moved west from Demak, Kyai Slamet organised resistance through the villages of the interior, and Kyai Ibrahim carried on a guerrilla war around Klaten and Wirabraja. The decisive Dutch personality was Governor-General Hendrik Merkus de Kock. After the relief of Yogyakarta he directed the large counter-offensive that turned the war from the defence of a city into the destruction of the rebel army, and he was then made director of the war in the East Indies, combining small hunting columns, amnesty and the sealing of the roads. In the line the commands passed to Carel Reynier and to Willem van der Does de Willebois; the reinforcement battalion sent out from the homeland in 1828 was led by Terhoudt; the Dutch commissioner Andries Beaulieu was killed in the fighting at the gates of Yogyakarta on 24 July; and the last operation was authorised by Governor-General Gustaaf Willem van Imhoff.
kits: 卡面這件西班牙火繩槍銃是十六世紀的標準火繩槍：比火槍輕，槍管約一公尺半，全槍連刺刀重約三公斤上下，槍口挂一條浸了硝石的火繩，扣下扳機即以蛇形機件把火繩燒向火藥池，擊發之後還得重新剪接火繩、添藥壓彈，一分鐘難得打上十幾發；射程約一百五十至二百公尺，五十步以內的精度最好。它是西班牙殖民軍步兵的骨幹裝備，也正是後來步槍與手槍的共同母型。爪哇戰爭爆發時，同類火繩槍銃自十六世紀以來隨貿易與傳教流入爪哇，仍散在民間與宮廷武庫：荷蘭文獻把這類槍叫作 baksel 或 wapen，爪哇語則叫 bedog，多是身管短、便於自備的散兵槍械，日惹與梭羅的宮廷武庫至今仍存有這類火繩槍的樣品。但野戰主力早已換成燧發式：荷屬東印度軍步兵用重約四公斤的燧發步槍，軍官與近衛佩帶燧發手槍，起義軍一面用繳獲的荷軍步槍與商船運入的舊槍，一面在鄉間自行鑄造銅砲，到一八二八至一八三〇年間，梭羅宮廷鑄成的巨型銅砲連同大量小口徑銅砲，使荷軍攻佔宮廷時一次繳獲數十門火砲。冷兵器方面，爪哇人用 tombak 長矛與 klewang 彎刀近身衝擊；荷軍除六磅與九磅野戰銅砲及曲射砲外，靠三寶壺至梭羅的大郵路運彈藥與糧秣，車隊、牛車與民夫是這條線的骨幹，全無鐵路與汽船可用。
kitsEn: The Spanish arquebus on this card is the standard matchlock gun of the sixteenth century: lighter than the arquebus of the heavier type, with a barrel of about a metre and a half, the whole piece weighing some three kilograms with its sword, a match cord soaked in saltpetre hanging at the muzzle, and a serpentine mechanism that brought the burning cord down onto the priming pan when the trigger was pulled. After each shot the cord had to be trimmed and replaced, powder added and the ball rammed home, so a man could hardly fire more than a dozen rounds a minute. Effective range was roughly one hundred and fifty to two hundred metres, with the best accuracy inside fifty paces. It was the backbone arm of the Spanish colonial infantry and is the common ancestor of the musket and the pistol that came after it. When the Java War broke out, matchlock arquebuses of this family had been reaching Java through trade and mission since the sixteenth century and were still scattered among the people and in the court arsenals: Dutch records call such guns baksel or wapen, while Javanese calls them bedog, and most were short-barrelled pieces carried by the men themselves; examples of this matchlock type still survive in the court arsenals at Yogyakarta and Surakarta. The real field arm, however, had long been the flintlock: the KNIL infantry carried flintlock muskets of about four kilograms and the officers and guards flintlock pistols, while the insurgents used the muskets they had captured and the old guns landed by merchant shipping, and in the villages they cast bronze cannon of their own, so that by 1828 and 1830 the great guns cast in the Surakarta court, together with a large number of small pieces, allowed the Dutch to take dozens of cannon in a single stroke when they entered the palace. In the way of cold weapons the Javanese used the tombak spear and the klewang broadsword at close quarters; the Dutch, besides their six- and nine-pounder bronze field guns and howitzers, moved powder, shot and provisions along the great post road from Semarang to Surakarta, with cart trains, bullock carts and coolie porters as the backbone of that line, there being neither railway nor steamship available.
tactics: 一八二五年的起義作戰是村社動員式的：村按戶出丁，村長領隊，戰鬥多發生在寨牆、水渠與椰林之間，火繩槍銃與火藥槍在近距離打成一片，長矛隊在側翼掩護射手。攻打日惹用的是分割突襲、夜襲與掘壕逼近，守軍以城牆與四角堡壘抵禦，靠南亞士兵的齊射與火槍隊的近射壓住街巷，荷方代表博利厄正是在城門外的交涉中被擊斃。解圍之後荷軍改取主動：德·科克以大縱隊直撲起義軍主力，步兵成列、散兵在前、砲兵居中，兩翼佈置騎兵，於一八二六年十月十五日的加沃克一役在梭羅河谷擊潰迪波內加羅本隊，奪其火砲、馬匹與輜重。戰局轉成游擊之後，荷軍的戰法歸納為打散、追蹤、封路三件事：組成兩三百人的搜索縱隊，配本地嚮導與偵察兵逐村搜索，在通往山區的路口設卡，於克拉丹、馬加良加與沙拉蒂加一線築壘駐防，切斷起義軍的糧鹽來源；同時推出招撫，對願意解散的村社發給證書與農具，把起義軍在鄉間的支援網拆散。起義軍則退入山區，靠熟悉的地形打夜襲與伏擊，在郵路與糧隊後方反覆出沒，迫使荷軍分兵，搜索縱隊常被拉散。火器差距在這一階段最要命：荷軍的燧發步槍在射程與精度上都勝過火繩槍銃，起義軍往往在數百步外以火繩槍銃射擊即退。
tacticsEn: The fighting of the rising in 1825 followed the pattern of a village mobilisation: villages furnished men household by household, village headmen led them, and the actual combat took place among stockades, irrigation ditches and coconut groves, where matchlock arquebuses and powder guns were used at close range while a spear formation covered the shooters on the flank. The attack on Yogyakarta was made by piecemeal assaults, night attacks and approaches by trench; the garrison held the town behind its walls and bastions and kept the streets under control with the volleys of the South Asian sepoys and the close fire of the musketeers, and it was outside the gates, in the course of a parley, that the Dutch commissioner Beaulieu was killed. After the relief the Dutch turned to the offensive: De Kock drove large columns straight at the main rebel army, infantry in line, skirmishers in front, artillery in the centre and cavalry on the wings, and on 15 October 1826 he destroyed Diponegoro's main body in the valley of the Solo river at the battle of Gawuk, taking its guns, horses and baggage. Once the war turned into a guerrilla war, the Dutch method reduced to three things: breaking up the enemy, tracking him and sealing the roads. Hunting columns of two or three hundred men, with local guides and scouts, searched village by village; posts were set at the entrances to the hills; forts were built along the line of Klaten, Magelang and Salatiga to cut the insurgents off from salt and grain; and at the same time an amnesty was offered, with certificates and tools for the villages that were willing to disband, so as to dismantle the network of support the insurgents had in the countryside. The insurgents withdrew into the hills, used their knowledge of the ground for night attacks and ambushes, and reappeared again and again behind the post road and the supply columns, obliging the Dutch to spread themselves thin so that their hunting columns were often broken up. The difference in small arms told most sharply at this stage: the Dutch flintlock muskets outranged and outshot the matchlock arquebus, and the insurgents as a rule fired from several hundred paces and withdrew.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。這場戰爭自一八二五年七月二十日起，到一八二九年荷方宣布大功告成、一八三〇年三月二十八日迪波內加羅被帶走，前後約五年。荷軍在爪哇的常備兵力，一八二五年時歐洲營約一千五百至二千人，自印度調來的土兵約二千人，本土步兵二千至三千人，皇家東印度砲兵約七百至八百人；一八二八年第二次遠征時總兵力增至一萬二千至一萬六千人上下，其中本土營隊約四千人、本土輔助步兵約四千人，同年抵爪哇的英軍輔助部隊約一千名英軍與數千名印度土兵。起義軍的規模無法核實：爪哇方面的說法在一八二六年已達數萬之眾，荷方則估計實際能戰之兵在數千至一萬之間，一八二八年之後迅速縮水，殘部不過數千。損失方面，加沃克一役荷軍自報傷亡數百人，起義軍陣亡與被俘以數千計，並丟失數十門火砲、大批馬匹與糧秣；全期荷軍陣亡以千計，戰費以百萬荷盾計，荷蘭議會曾為此專門質詢。時間與距離同樣可考：塞拉至日惹約四十公里，日惹至梭羅約一百一十公里，三寶壺至梭羅的大郵路約二百五十公里，一八二五年八月出發的援軍自三寶壺西行用了約一個半月才抵達日惹一線。爪哇方面的原始記載多散佚於殖民檔案與事後整理，起義軍一方的數字往往出自對立一方之口，諸說並存。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war began on 20 July 1825 and reached its formal Dutch conclusion in 1829, with the capture of Diponegoro on 28 March 1830, so it lasted about five years. The Dutch establishment in Java in 1825 was some one thousand five hundred to two thousand European troops, about two thousand sepoys brought from India, two to three thousand native infantry, and seven to eight hundred men of the colonial artillery; by the second expedition of 1828 the total had risen to something between twelve and sixteen thousand, of which about four thousand were European battalions and about four thousand native auxiliaries, joined in the same year by roughly a thousand British troops and several thousand Indian sepoys as an auxiliary force. The size of the rebel army cannot be verified: Javanese accounts claimed tens of thousands by 1826, while the Dutch put the actual fighting strength at between several thousand and ten thousand, and it shrank rapidly after 1828 to a few thousand men. On losses, the Dutch reported several hundred casualties at Gawuk, while the insurgents lost thousands killed and captured and left behind dozens of cannon, large numbers of horses and their stores; Dutch dead over the whole war ran into the thousands, and the cost of the campaign ran into millions of guilders, a matter on which the Dutch parliament questioned the government. Time and distance can be checked as well: Sela lies some forty kilometres from Yogyakarta, Yogyakarta some one hundred and ten from Surakarta, and the great post road from Semarang to Surakarta about two hundred and fifty; the relief column that set out from Semarang in August 1825 took roughly a month and a half to reach the neighbourhood of Yogyakarta. The original Javanese records were largely lost, surviving only in colonial archives and later compilations, and the insurgents' own figures usually come from the mouths of their adversaries, so the accounts differ.
cause: 起因可以分四層。第一層是主權與土地：荷蘭在一八二〇年代把重建蘇丹宮的名目留在紙上，卻以駐紮官制度接管日惹、梭羅與馬加良卡的宮廷庶政，宮廷的土地、灌溉與稅收都要經巴達維亞核准，宮廷殘存的傳統權柄被一層層削薄。第二層是生計：東印度公司在十九世紀初推廣咖啡、靛藍等出口作物，荷蘭官吏要求爪哇農民交出田地與勞力去種，租稅與雜費年年加派，爪哇村社因此普遍破產，被迫借貸與遷徙。第三層是宗教與身分成見：改宗傳教團自一八二〇年起在中部爪哇設站，爪哇伊斯蘭學者普遍擔心傳教與歐洲人的生活方式會改變村社的信仰，迪波內加羅的號召正是把這種普遍的恐懼變成政治語言。第四層才是直接的導火線：一八二五年上半年宮中兩派爭寵，他本人被排擠，其弟被荷方另行抬出，宮廷又答應向荷蘭移交土地與產業；他在被派往邊境巡視時獲知這一連串消息，遂在塞拉宣布聖戰，兩個月內攻下日惹，把一場宮廷權鬥變成了爪哇對荷蘭的全面戰爭。
causeEn: The causes can be separated into four layers. The first was sovereignty and land. Through the 1820s the Dutch left the formula of reconstructing the kraton on paper while taking over the civil administration of Yogyakarta, Surakarta and Magelang through the residency system: the lands, irrigation and taxes of the court all had to pass the approval of Batavia, and what was left of the court's traditional authority was whittled away layer by layer. The second was livelihood. In the early nineteenth century the East India company pushed coffee, indigo and other export crops, and Dutch officials required Javanese cultivators to give up land and labour for them, while rents and levies were increased year by year, so that the villages of Java were generally ruined and driven to borrow and to move. The third was religion and the fear of loss of standing: Protestant mission stations had been established in central Java from 1820 onward, and Javanese Islamic scholars were generally alarmed that missionary activity and European ways of life would change the faith of the villages, so Diponegoro's call turned that widespread fear into political language. The fourth layer is the immediate occasion. In the first half of 1825 the two factions at court struggled for the sultan's favour: he himself was pushed aside, his younger brother was put forward with Dutch support, and the court agreed to hand over land and enterprises to the Dutch. Learning all of this while he was sent out on tour in the border districts, he proclaimed the holy war at Sela, and within two months he was in Yogyakarta; a struggle inside the palace had become a general war of Java against the Dutch.
impact: 影響深而且長。第一，爪哇最後一個能獨立的國家機器被打碎：日惹、梭羅與馬加良卡的宮廷失去了召集丁壯、徵收貢賦與主持裁決的能力，荷蘭的駐紮官由顧問變成實質的統治者，爪哇的政治中心從宮廷移到巴達維亞。其直接後果是荷蘭得以在爪哇推行一八三〇年制度化的栽培制度，以出口作物與強制的勞役供應世界市場，同時把大批村社土地轉為租地，爪哇農村的負債與匱乏因此加深。第二，抵抗並未斷絕：迪波內加羅被流放到蘇門答臘米南加保，一八三五年死在那裡，死訊激起中部爪哇一八三六至一八三九年的新戰事；他的名字與部眾後來在一八四八至一八四九年的爪哇反荷起義中被再度舉起，荷蘭被迫改用更嚴厲的鎮壓手段，中部爪哇此後長期籠罩在戒嚴與加派稅賦之下。第三，這場戰爭改變了荷蘭的用兵方式：它讓巴達維亞明白，在爪哇作戰必須倚重本地步兵、道路與嚴密的後勤，而不是只靠歐洲營；此後的亞齊戰爭幾乎照搬同一套辦法。第四，在國際上，爪哇戰爭成了歐洲人討論殖民政權能否用武力改造伊斯蘭社會的案例，而一八二八年英軍抵爪哇助戰時部分連隊曾劫掠日惹蘇丹宮，荷方事後不得不向倫敦交涉賠償，這一段不體面的記錄在當時的歐洲輿論中傳開。
impactEn: The consequences were deep and long. First, the last independent state machinery in Java was broken: the courts of Yogyakarta, Surakarta and Magelang lost the power to call up levies, to collect tribute and to sit in judgement, the Dutch residency changed from an adviser into an actual governor, and the political centre of Java moved from the palace to Batavia. The direct consequence was that the Dutch could institute in Java the cultivation system, formalised in 1830, supplying the world market with export crops and with compulsory labour while turning much village land into plantation holdings, so that debt and want among the Javanese peasantry deepened. Second, the resistance did not stop. Diponegoro was exiled to Minangkabau in Sumatra and died there in 1835, and the news of his death set off new fighting in central Java between 1836 and 1839; his name and his followers were raised again in the anti-Dutch rising of 1848 and 1849, after which the Dutch fell back on harsher repression, and central Java remained under martial law and heavier taxation for years. Third, the war changed the way the Dutch fought. It taught Batavia that a war in Java had to be fought with native infantry, with roads and with strict logistics rather than with European battalions alone, and the Aceh war that followed copied that method almost entirely. Fourth, in international terms the Java War became a case study in the European debate on whether a colonial power could remake an Islamic society by force, and when British troops reached Java in 1828 to assist the Dutch, part of the force looted the palace of Yogyakarta, so that the Dutch had to negotiate compensation with London, and that piece of disgrace was talked about in Europe at the time.
result: 結果分三段。第一段是一八二五年的城市攻防與一八二六年的會戰：日惹城於九月下旬解圍，荷軍在加沃克擊潰起義軍主力，起義軍的火砲與糧秣盡入荷軍之手，士氣與物資同時崩落。第二段是漫長的消耗：一八二六年末德·科克被任命為東印度戰爭總監之後，荷軍以搜索縱隊、據點封鎖與招撫並行，起義軍退守中部山區，分裂成無數小股，兩位攝政王與部分的伊瑪目陸續與荷方達成協議，迪波內加羅的直屬部眾被逐步瓦解。一八二八年荷蘭本土援兵與英軍輔助部隊抵達，第二次遠征在中部山區反覆搜索，最終把迪波內加羅逼回馬加良納的住處；一八三〇年三月八日他在孟庫內加羅簽下歸順的文件，三月二十八日被一支小分隊帶走，先押往巴達維亞，最後流放到蘇門答臘的米南加保。第三段是長期的制度安排：荷方保留一個由自己認可的蘇丹，給他宮廷與俸祿，把實權交給駐紮官與各縣官吏，並在一八三〇年代把中部爪哇劃為常駐軍與警衛駐防的區域。爪哇的主權形式被保留，實權卻一點一點收進巴達維亞的檔案裡。荷蘭贏得了這場戰爭，輸掉的是蘇丹宮作為政治中心的正當性；餘波要到一九四五年以後才會在別的形式裡重新浮現。
resultEn: The result came in three stages. The first was the urban fighting of 1825 and the pitched battle of 1826: Yogyakarta was relieved in the last week of September, the Dutch destroyed the main rebel army at Gawuk, the insurgents' guns and stores fell into Dutch hands, and morale and supply broke together. The second was the long attrition. After De Kock was made director of the war in the East Indies at the end of 1826, the Dutch combined hunting columns, the sealing of posts and amnesty, and the insurgents withdrew into the hills of the interior and broke up into countless small bands, while the two regents and a number of the imams came to terms with the Dutch one after another and Diponegoro's own following was gradually dissolved. In 1828 the reinforcements from the homeland and the British auxiliary force reached Java, and the second expedition searched the central hills again and again until Diponegoro was driven back to his house at Margarana; on 8 March 1830 he signed the document of submission at Mangkunegaran, and on 28 March he was taken away by a small party, first to Batavia and finally into exile at Minangkabau in Sumatra. The third stage was the long institutional settlement: the Dutch kept a sultan whom they recognised, gave him a court and a salary, handed real power to the residents and the district officials, and in the 1830s turned central Java into a zone of permanent garrison and police posts. The form of Javanese sovereignty was preserved while the substance was drawn, piece by piece, into the archives of Batavia. The Dutch won the war and lost the legitimacy of the palace as a political centre; the ripples of that loss were not to surface again in another form until after 1945.
